decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Charizard Y. Lead Charizard-Raichu denies the opponent’s most dangerous early Trick Room lines with Fake Out and Encore while Charizard establishes sun and threatens broad damage. Venusaur converts sun into fast Sleep Powder and Solar Beam pressure; Garchomp is the back cleaner once Mamoswine/Meowscarada are managed.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 preview plan: Mega Charizard Y is the selected Mega. Preferred four versus this roster are Charizard, Raichu, Venusaur, Garchomp. Preserve Raichu for Fake Out/Encore against Hatterene Trick Room and use Venusaur’s Chlorophyll sun speed to control the midgame. Keep Garchomp away from early Mamoswine and Meowscarada pressure when possible.

decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar+Torkoal to establish sun control and Intimidate immediately. Incineroar FakeOut disrupts opponent's turn 1 while Torkoal's Drought+Charcoal HeatWave pressures the sun core. Mamoswine backline provides Ice Shard priority for Garchomp/Talonflame and Focus Sash insurance. Mega Metagross in slot 4 handles Venusaur/Raichu with Tough Claws Meteor Mash and resists key attacks. This lead/back combo maximizes sun control, speed control via priority, and late-game cleaning power.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs sun-centric Mega Charizard Y core with Garchomp/Venusaur synergy. Key threats: Charizard Y HeatWave under Drought, Garchomp Earthquake+RockSlide spread, Talonflame Gale Wings BraveBird priority, Venusaur Chlorophyll speed in sun. My counters: Incineroar Intimidate+Fire resist vs Charizard, Mamoswine Ice Shard priority for Garchomp/Talonflame, Mega Metagross for Venusaur/Raichu, Torkoal Drought to contest sun. Hatterene Trick Room+Magic Bounce available as alternative speed control. Meowscarada Flower Trick OHKOes Primarina. Always verify speed tiers before committing to non-priority attacks.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out denies Torkoal’s high-power sun Eruption while Mega Charizard Y refreshes sun and Heat Wave pressures both foes. Raichu acts before Incineroar’s Fake Out, so Torkoal is stopped even if Raichu is flinched afterward. This preserves the strongest immediate board position against their slow sun lead.
decisions.notebook: Opponent led Incineroar + Torkoal in game 1. Maintain Mega Charizard Y as intended Mega; Venusaur and Garchomp remain preferred backline. Preserve Raichu’s Encore/Fake Out utility for Hatterene Trick Room when feasible.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out on Raichu prevents its Fake Out/Nuzzle/Encour disruption and guarantees Incineroar acts first. Heat Wave hits both foes; Charizard resists but Raichu takes neutral damage. Charizard's Heat Wave is NVE vs both my Fire types, so even if it attacks after Fake Out, damage is manageable. This is the most aggressive yet safe opening.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Charizard Y + Raichu in sun. Raichu has Mental Herb (Taunt immunity) + Lightning Rod. Charizard Y SolarPower boosts SpA in sun but drains HP. Key threats: Raichu speed control (Fake Out/Nuzzle/Encore), Charizard Heat Wave spread. My Incineroar Intimidate already dropped both foes' Attack. Torkoal Drought maintains sun. Consider switching to Mamoswine/Metagross if opponent brings Garchomp/Venusaur. Hatterene TR is backup speed control. Meowscarada Flower Trick counters Primarina.

decisions.rationale: Air Slash is a guaranteed KO on Torkoal from its shown HP and Charizard always moves first, removing the sun-boosted Eruption threat before it acts. Nuzzle gives immediate speed control on Incineroar and punishes its likely Parting Shot/pivot; Encore is unreliable after Torkoal flinched.

Both foes outspeed us significantly. Raichu Fake Out into Torkoal is highly likely again, and we cannot afford another flinch. Torkoal Protect blocks Fake Out and any Heat Wave. Incineroar Parting Shot drops both foes' Atk/SpA by 1 each (stacking with Intimidate to -2 Atk), weakening their damage output while we reposition. This is safer than attacking into faster foes and preserves Torkoal for a clean Eruption/Heat Wave next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent consistently leads Charizard-Y + Raichu in sun. Raichu carries Mental Herb + Lightning Rod, prefers Fake Out turn 1-2. Charizard-Y SolarPower drains HP in sun but boosts SpA. Intimidate stacking via Parting Shot is valuable against physical attackers. Torkoal vulnerable to Fake Out flinch chain - Protect is essential when Raichu active. Consider Metagross Mega as wincon vs Garchomp/Venusaur cores. Mamoswine Ice Shard priority useful for faster threats.

decisions.rationale: Metagross resists Raichu's Electric moves and can Mega Evolve into a win condition vs Garchomp/Venusaur. Torkoal passing avoids Fake Out flinch. Metagross tanks Charizard's Fire better than paralyzed Incineroar and sets up mid-game advantage.
decisions.notebook: Opponent consistently leads Charizard-Y + Raichu in sun. Raichu has Mental Herb + Lightning Rod, prefers Fake Out turn 1-2. Charizard-Y SolarPower drains HP in sun but boosts SpA. Intimidate stacking via Parting Shot valuable vs physical attackers. Torkoal vulnerable to Fake Out flinch chain - Protect essential when Raichu active. Metagross Mega is wincon vs Garchomp/Venusaur cores. Mamoswine Ice Shard priority useful for faster threats. Venusaur Chlorophyll outspeeds in sun. Talonflame GaleWings Brave Bird priority is dangerous. Track Raichu Fake Out PP usage.

decisions.rationale: Encore acts before Torkoal and forces its revealed last-move Protect, denying Eruption even if the reduced-success Protect fails. Charizard is guaranteed faster than Metagross and sun-boosted Heat Wave threatens the crucial Metagross KO while also covering a Torkoal switch. Raichu’s utility is worth risking because Encore removes the immediate spread-KO line.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Incineroar revealed Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, Crunch and is Impish Sitrus; it used Parting Shot into Raichu and was paralyzed by Nuzzle. Torkoal revealed Eruption, Heat Wave, Earth Power, Protect and has Charcoal; Encore can exploit its Protect. Metagross is Adamant Metagrossite with Meteor Mash, Ice Punch, Bullet Punch, Protect. Maintain Mega Charizard Y plan; Venusaur and Garchomp are preferred endgame, with Raichu Encore/Fake Out especially valuable versus Hatterene Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Raichu at 83% is vulnerable to Ice Punch (29.9-75.6%). Torkoal's Eruption in sun pressures both foes. Raichu will likely Fake Out Torkoal, risking flinch, but even if Torkoal acts, Eruption + Ice Punch can KO or heavily damage Raichu while chipping Charizard. Saving Mega for later matchups vs Garchomp/Venusaur.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Charizard-Y + Raichu consistently. Raichu Fake Out PP tracking important (used turn 1, available turn 3). Torkoal Protect chain vulnerable to reduced success rate. Metagross Mega wincon vs Garchomp/Venusaur cores. Incineroar Parting Shot valuable for Intimidate stacking. Venusaur Chlorophyll outspeeds in sun. Talonflame GaleWings Brave Bird priority threat. Mental Herb likely consumed. Track Fake Out PP carefully.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar provides crucial Intimidate stacking (Charizard -2, Raichu -3 Atk), Fire resistance to absorb Heat Wave, and Dark typing resists Fake Out. Torkoal is Encored into Protect which will likely fail, but both Fire types resist Charizard's likely Heat Wave. Mamoswine risks immediate KO: Fake Out breaks Sash, then super-effective Heat Wave finishes it.
decisions.notebook: Opponent consistently leads Charizard-Y + Raichu. Raichu Fake Out PP: used turn 1, available turn 3+. Mental Herb likely consumed on Raichu. Torkoal Protect chain at high failure risk after 2 consecutive uses. Venusaur Chlorophyll outspeeds everything in sun - major threat if switched in. Talonflame GaleWings Brave Bird priority is dangerous to weakened targets. Incineroar Parting Shot is key for Intimidate stacking strategy. Metagross Mega was wincon vs Garchomp/Venusaur but fainted early - need alternative late-game plan. Track opponent's switch patterns to identify their core pairing preferences.

decisions.rationale: Torkoal is locked into a heavily reduced-success Protect, so Raichu need not expose itself. Air Slash gives the best focused pressure on Incineroar without risking Heat Wave accuracy or wasting damage into Protect; Protect also denies a possible Earth Power if Encore ends unexpectedly and preserves Raichu for Hatterene.

Torkoal is Encored into Protect with heavily reduced success rate after 2 consecutive uses. Switching to Mamoswine brings in a fresh 100% HP Focus Sash Pokémon while Incineroar's Fake Out (+3 priority) guarantees Raichu flinches and cannot act. This resets the board safely: Mamoswine threatens both foes with Ice Shard priority or Earthquake, Incineroar maintains Intimidate pressure, and we avoid the risk of Torkoal's Protect failing while it's locked into the move. Preserve Incineroar HP for repeated Intimidate switches. Mamoswine Ice Shard priority +1 can pick off weakened fast threats.

decisions.rationale: Icicle Crash is a guaranteed OHKO on Charizard, so Protect preserves the key attacker. Raichu outspeeds and Encore locks Incineroar into its prior Fake Out, which cannot provide useful pressure here and should force a switch. This also lets Raichu Encore Mamoswine’s revealed attack next turn while Charizard can reposition safely.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Incineroar is Impish Sitrus with Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, Crunch; it is vulnerable to Encore after Fake Out/Parting Shot and is paralyzed. Torkoal is Quiet Charcoal with Eruption, Heat Wave, Earth Power, Protect; Encore punishes Protect. Mamoswine is Adamant Focus Sash with Icicle Crash, Earthquake, Ice Shard, Protect; preserve Charizard from Icicle Crash and exploit Encore after it commits. Maintain Mega Charizard Y endgame; Venusaur/Garchomp remain preferred reserves.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine Protect blocks Charizard's Heat Wave/Solar Beam (both 2x), preserving Focus Sash. Incineroar Parting Shot on Raichu drops both foes' Attack/SpA further (now -3/-4 Atk on Raichu, -3/-2 on Charizard), stacking Intimidate pressure. Incineroar is too slow (paralyzed, Spe 40) to act before foes anyway, so using it to debuff while protecting Mamoswine is optimal. This sets up a favorable switch-in next turn with Torkoal or another Pokémon while opponents are heavily weakened offensively.

decisions.rationale: Preserve Charizard from Mamoswine’s Ice attacks while Incineroar is forced to fail with Fake Out. Raichu outspeeds Mamoswine and Encore either punishes Protect or locks its selected attack, creating a controllable position for Venusaur and the preserved Charizard endgame.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar is Encore'd into Fake Out which fails (not first turn out), so only Struggle is available. Mamoswine Earthquake hits Raichu 2x (immune Charizard), likely KOing 83% Raichu given 187 Atk. If Raichu falls, we get 2v1 vs -2 Atk Charizard. Mamoswine's Focus Sash is preserved. Opponent's best response is Protect from one, but we still pressure heavily. Heat Wave from Charizard would OHKO Mamoswine through Sash if not protected, but we're committing to the KO play.

decisions.rationale: Remove the low Incineroar immediately with guaranteed Sludge Bomb while Raichu avoids any Ground attack. Mamoswine is still locked into a failed Protect, so this converts the board into a favorable 2v1; Venusaur retains Focus Sash for its eventual Ice attack.

Incineroar is Encore'd into Struggle which causes recoil damage at 28% HP - switching preserves it for future Intimidate/Parting Shot utility. Mamoswine is Encore'd into Protect; using it blocks Venusaur's likely SolarBeam (2x on Mamoswine, breaks Focus Sash). Raichu's Nuzzle is immune vs Mamoswine. This line minimizes risk while maintaining board presence.

Double-switch denies Incineroar a free super-effective Fire hit and avoids leaving Raichu exposed to Earthquake. Mamoswine is still locked into Protect, so Charizard and Garchomp enter safely enough and create a strong Sun endgame; Garchomp’s Earthquake is ally-safe beside Flying Charizard.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine is Encore'd into Protect only. Venusaur with Chlorophyll in sun (200-264 Speed) will outspeed both and likely SolarBeam Mamoswine for 2x damage. Incineroar Flare Blitz is super-effective on Venusaur and can KO through Focus Sash (already at 82%). Even if Protect fails on Mamoswine, removing Venusaur eliminates the sun sweeper threat. Raichu at -4 Atk is minimal damage threat and Nuzzle is immune on Mamoswine.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur Chlorophyll in sun is primary threat - must be removed quickly. Raichu Mental Herb likely consumed after multiple Encores. Mamoswine Focus Sash preserved for Ice Shard cleanup. Incineroar Intimidate stacking effective. Opponent switches Venusaur when pressured. Talonflame Gale Wings Brave Bird priority dangerous to weakened targets. Garchomp/Primarina possible switches if pressured further. Fake Out fails if user not freshly switched in.

decisions.rationale: Protect denies the immediate Fake Out/Icicle Crash line into Garchomp. Solar Beam is guaranteed to move before Mamoswine, breaks its Focus Sash, and leaves Garchomp protected from its strongest Ice attack; next turn Charizard can finish Mamoswine before Garchomp acts while Garchomp survives a lone Ice Shard from full.

Mamoswine Ice Shard (priority +1) moves before both foes (114 < 132-169), giving ~50% KO chance on Garchomp and preventing its EQ on Incineroar. Incineroar Parting Shot lowers both foes' Atk/SpA; if Garchomp survives and EQs first, Incineroar faints before acting, but if Garchomp is KO'd, the stat drop cripples Charizard's offensive pressure on Mamoswine. Crunch+Ice Shard doesn't guarantee KO (min 70%), making Parting Shot's long-term value superior.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur Chlorophyll in sun remains primary threat - must be removed quickly if brought. Raichu Mental Herb likely consumed; Encore less threatening. Mamoswine Focus Sash preserved for Ice Shard cleanup priority. Incineroar Intimidate stacking effective but HP critically low. Opponent switches Venusaur when pressured. Garchomp Life Orb + Rough Skin punishes contact; avoid unnecessary hits. Charizard-Mega-Y Solar Beam 2x on Mamoswine breaks Sash; Thick Fat only halves Fire/Ice. Talonflame Gale Wings Brave Bird priority dangerous to weakened targets if brought. Primarina not brought yet - HydroPump/Moonblast threaten Fire types. Track opponent's tendency to Protect when pressured vs aggressive EQ/Heat Wave.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp cannot safely act: Ice Shard is a guaranteed KO before its priority-0 moves. Preserve it by switching to Venusaur while Charizard’s sun-boosted Heat Wave has guaranteed KO ranges on both low foes if it connects. Venusaur also exploits sun as the backup cleaner if Mamoswine Protects or Heat Wave misses.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Incineroar is Impish Sitrus with Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, Crunch; it is paralyzed and Encore punishes Fake Out/Parting Shot. Torkoal is Quiet Charcoal with Eruption, Heat Wave, Earth Power, Protect; Encore punishes Protect. Mamoswine is Adamant Focus Sash with Icicle Crash, Earthquake, Ice Shard, Protect; preserve Garchomp from Ice Shard and exploit Encore after it commits. Maintain Mega Charizard Y endgame; Venusaur/Garchomp remain preferred reserves.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar at 16% HP paralyzed cannot survive Garchomp EQ (2x). Crunch on Garchomp is neutral and avoids Rough Skin recoil from Flare Blitz. Mamoswine Ice Shard on Garchomp is +1 priority 4x SE, hitting before Garchomp's EQ regardless of speed. If Garchomp Protects, Ice Shard wastes but Crunch still damages Charizard next turn. Flare Blitz would KO Incineroar via recoil. Parting Shot is inferior since we need damage now.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur Chlorophyll in sun remains primary threat - must be removed quickly if brought. Raichu Mental Herb likely consumed. Garchomp Life Orb + Rough Skin punishes contact moves; prefer non-contact or priority. Charizard-Mega-Y Solar Beam 2x on Mamoswine breaks Sash; Thick Fat only halves Fire/Ice. Opponent tends to Protect when pressured. Incineroar Intimidate stacking valuable but HP management critical. Track opponent's Protect patterns for prediction opportunities.

reflections.summary: Won because the Charizard-Y/Venusaur/Raichu/Garchomp preview plan matched their slow Fire core and Mamoswine well: Encore shut down Fake Out and Protect, then sun pressure and careful Garchomp protection converted the endgame. Mega Charizard Y was the correct Mega despite Mamoswine’s Ice pressure.
reflections.adjustment: Bring the same four if their shown core returns, but prioritize Raichu positioning early to threaten Encore on Incineroar or Mamoswine; keep Garchomp protected or off the field until Mamoswine’s Ice Shard is accounted for.
reflections.notebook: Incineroar’s Fake Out and Parting Shot are highly punishable with Encore; it also showed Flare Blitz and Crunch. Torkoal showed Charcoal Eruption/Heat Wave/Earth Power/Protect and can be trapped on Protect by Encore. Mamoswine is Focus Sash with Ice Shard, Icicle Crash, Earthquake, and Protect; respect Ice Shard against Garchomp and use Encore to exploit Protect. Charizard-Y/Venusaur/Raichu/Garchomp is a suitable four into this revealed composition; Mega Charizard Y remains the preferred Mega.

reflections.summary: The loss was caused by a flawed team-preview plan: bringing Torkoal (Drought) directly enabled the opponent’s Chlorophyll Venusaur and Mega Charizard Y’s Solar Beam, granting them overwhelming speed and type coverage. Raichu’s Encore locked Incineroar and Mamoswine into failed actions, while Garchomp’s Rough Skin and Life Orb punished contact moves. Without a dedicated sun counter or speed control, the team was systematically dismantled.
reflections.adjustment: Drop Torkoal and bring Metagross-Mega to safely check the sun core and provide priority. Lead with a faster pivot or use Taunt to disrupt Raichu’s Encore, and prioritize non-contact moves (Ice Shard, Earth Power) to avoid Garchomp’s Rough Skin punishment.
reflections.notebook: Drought is a severe liability vs Chlorophyll Venusaur + Mega Charizard Y; avoid sun setters in preview. Raichu Encore is their primary disruption tool; must be pressured or Taunted early. Garchomp LO + Rough Skin heavily punishes contact; favor special/priority attacks. Charizard-MY relies on Solar Beam to bypass Ice/Ground typing and break Focus Sash. Opponent Protects predictively under pressure; exploit with spread moves or switches. Metagross-Mega is the optimal answer to their sun core; prioritize it over Drought setters in future games.
